cast_dialogue.linea: Three doors, heroes: the zero conditional for facts, the first for real futures, the second for beautiful dreams.
If you heat ice, it melts. Science! And if it rains tomorrow, I'll stay home and edit photos.
If I win the lottery, I'll buy a ramen restaurant. If I were rich, I'd travel the world first!
If you study hard, you'll pass the exam. And if I had a superpower, I'd fly to Japan every weekend.
If you don't water the plants, they die. And if I were twenty again, mis héroes, I'd dance tango every night.

banco_oraciones.oracion: If you heat ice, it melts. (fact)
If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay home. (real future)
If I were rich, I'd travel the world. (dream)
If you study hard, you'll pass the exam.
If you don't water plants, they die.
If she doesn't hurry, she won't catch the bus.
If I weren't tired, I wouldn't go to bed.
What happens if you freeze water?
What will you do if it rains?
What would you do if you won the lottery?
Will you come if it rains? Yes, I will.
Would you fly if you could? Yes, I would.
Does ice melt if you heat it? Yes, it does.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Zero: if + present, present (facts). First: if + present, will (real future). Second: if + past, would (imaginary now). Never use 'will' in the if-clause! With 'be', prefer 'were' for all persons in the second conditional.

filas: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, I'll stay home.

If I win ✅ / If I will win ❌

The second conditional talks about imaginary situations now.

guion: Kenji: What will you do if it rains tomorrow, Ben?
Ben: If it rains, I'll stay home and edit photos. And you?
Kenji: If I have time, I'll cook ramen for everyone.
Sofía: And what would you do if you won the lottery?
Kenji: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a ramen restaurant!
Ben: And if I were rich, I'd travel the world.
Sofía: Well, if you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus. Let's go!

comprension.pregunta: What will Ben do if it rains?
What would Kenji buy if he won the lottery?

reading.texto: The friends love the 'if' game. Ben is practical: if it rains tomorrow, he will stay home and edit photos. Kenji is a dreamer: if he won the lottery, he would buy a ramen restaurant. Sofía is wise: if you study hard, you pass your exams — that is almost a fact, like water boiling at one hundred degrees. Abuela Carmen smiles: if she were twenty again, she would dance tango every night.

preguntas.afirmacion: Ben will go out if it rains.
Kenji would buy a restaurant if he won the lottery.
Abuela Carmen dances tango every night now.
